title: Data centers, power and how to be a winner in the AI Boom
excerpt: The energy sector's AI boom amidst current grid challenges
content_html:
The data center industry has found itself in unchartered waters recently. The boom in demand for AI tools and services has led to a 17% increase in electricity consumption. And despite a rapid decline in power consumption per AI task, energy consumption is set to triple for AI-focused facilities.

Recent industry research also reveals the average cost of unplanned downtime has climbed to $9,000 per minute, or $540,000 per hour. For large enterprises, major outages can exceed $5 million per hour when all factors are considered.

Even more sobering: 60% of small and medium businesses that experience catastrophic data loss close within six months.

Global Sector Head of Data Centres at Aggreko.

For data centers, power is non-negotiable, and it’s clear that for those who can take control of their power supply, success in this AI boom can be achieved.

But the challenges are also clear. Europe’s existing, and ageing, grid infrastructure is becoming unreliable under the demand of data centers, renewables, and electric vehicles.

Data centers will not always be the priority, but the need for consistent operations cannot falter. Not if businesses want to stay competitive in a crowd that is growing.

The ripples of change

The AI boom is redefining success and failure within the energy sector. And the standout feature of the winners is the access to a reliable power supply. Bloom Energy’s 2026 power report, which looks at developments in the US data center market, indicates a clear trend from areas where the grid is strained to those with ample supply.

Traditional leaders are making way for the new, with data showing that areas like California, Oregon, Iowa, and Nebraska are set to lose up to 50% of their market share due to tighter power availability. Meanwhile Texas’ data center load is set to more than double by 2028. A reliable power supply is not only an advantage, but is king, when considering the construction of new facilities. 

For nearly 20 years, I’ve worked in the sector, on a variety of projects and continents. One I’ve learnt is that the age-old idiom "when America sneezes, the world catches a cold” is true. The lessons of this dramatic shift in the US market should be understood and acted on by leaders in Europe sooner rather than later. 

And the question for European data center operators is obvious – how can you stay take control of your own power availability and stay afloat?

From dependence to independence

The answer for many has been independence away from grid energy. Rooted in the need to avoid grid capacity challenges and delays due to waiting lists, Bloom’s report indicates  that up to a third of US data centers are expected to be fully off-grid by 2030. And this data on decentralization is growing. The IEA has observed a sharp increase in orders for gas turbines, with the intention to power data centers directly, circumventing a grid connection. 

But this specific solution isn’t without its drawbacks. For example, gas turbines alone struggle to support the large swings in demand that are induced by AI training and modelling.

Increasingly, businesses are finding Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are key to overcoming these sudden waves of demand. BESS can act as a buffer for the load swings AI produces when implemented as a supplementary power source. And the IEA forecasts that up to 25GW of battery storage could be installed in data centers globally by 2030. 

At Aggreko, we’re already deploying this option for a number of our partners across Europe, ranging from 10MW all the way up to loads in excess of 100MW. For example, when a major colocation provider in Dublin found that they would not be able to connect their data center to the grid until several months after the site came online, we were called upon to bridge the gap in the meantime. 

We supplied 12 next-generation gas (NGG) generators  totaling 14MWe, including 10kV of switchgears, transformers, and auxiliary equipment that allowed the site to operate entirely independent of the grid. This was supported by a 1MW BESS, providing resilience against energy swings with the added benefits of improved power quality, emission reduction, and fuel savings. As a result, the site was online right away, compared to the estimated two-year delay for a grid connection. 

Staying ahead of the curve

The pace of development has been faster than anticipated for most operators, which has led to dramatic shifts in the way they approach power and cooling.

So, secure your energy supply, start decentralizing, and stay on top of new technologies, such as BESS, and you might just find your company winning the AI boom.

content_html_zh:
数据中心行业最近发现自己处于未知领域。 对人工智能工具和服务的需求激增导致电力消耗增加17%。 尽管每个人工智能任务的功耗迅速下降，但以人工智能为中心的设施的能耗将增加两倍。

更发人深省的是：60% 经历过灾难性数据丢失的中小型企业在六个月内倒闭。

Aggreko 数据中心全球部门主管。

对于数据中心来说，电力是不容谈判的，很明显，对于那些能够控制电力供应的人来说，就可以在这场人工智能热潮中取得成功。

数据中心并不总是优先考虑的，但一致运营的需求不能动摇。 如果企业想在不断增长的人群中保持竞争力，则不然。

变革的涟漪

人工智能的繁荣正在重新定义能源领域的成功和失败。 获胜者的突出特点是获得可靠的电力供应。 Bloom Energy 的 2026 年电力报告着眼于美国数据中心市场的发展，表明从电网紧张地区到供应充足地区的明显趋势。

传统领导者正在为新领导者让路，数据显示，由于电力供应紧张，加利福尼亚州、俄勒冈州、爱荷华州和内布拉斯加州等地区将失去多达 50% 的市场份额。 与此同时，到 2028 年，德克萨斯州的数据中心负载将增加一倍以上。 在考虑建设新设施时，可靠的电力供应不仅是一个优势，而且是最重要的。

近 20 年来，我一直在该领域工作，参与过各种项目和大洲。 我学到的一个道理是，“美国打喷嚏，世界就会感冒”这句古老的谚语是对的。 欧洲领导人应该尽早了解美国市场这一巨大转变的教训并采取行动。

欧洲数据中心运营商面临的问题是显而易见的——如何才能继续控制自己的电力供应并维持运营？

从依赖到独立

许多人的答案是独立于电网能源。 Bloom 的报告指出，出于避免电网容量挑战和因等待名单造成的延误的需要，预计到 2030 年，多达三分之一的美国数据中心将完全脱离电网。 有关权力下放的数据正在不断增长。 IEA 观察到燃气轮机订单急剧增加，目的是绕过电网连接直接为数据中心供电。

但这种特定的解决方案并非没有缺点。 例如，仅燃气轮机就很难支持人工智能训练和建模引起的需求大幅波动。

越来越多的企业发现电池储能系统 (BESS) 是克服这些突然出现的需求浪潮的关键。 当作为补充电源实施时，BESS 可以充当 AI 产生的负载波动的缓冲器。 IEA 预测，到 2030 年，全球数据中心将安装高达 25GW 的电池存储。

在亚力克，我们已经为欧洲的许多合作伙伴部署了这一选项，负载范围从 10MW 一直到超过 100MW。 例如，当都柏林的一家主要托管提供商发现他们的数据中心要到网站上线几个月后才能连接到电网时，我们被要求同时弥补这一差距。

我们提供了 12 台总功率为 14MWe 的下一代天然气 (NGG) 发电机，包括 10kV 的开关设备、变压器和辅助设备，使该站点能够完全独立于电网运行。 这得到了 1MW BESS 的支持，提供了抵御能源波动的能力，并具有改善电能质量、减少排放和节省燃料等额外好处。 结果，该站点立即上线，而电网连接预计会延迟两年。

保持领先地位

对于大多数运营商来说，发展速度比预期的要快，这导致他们处理电力和冷却的方式发生了巨大转变。

因此，确保您的能源供应，开始分散化，并掌握 BESS 等新技术，您可能会发现您的公司赢得了人工智能热潮。
